# Sharp-Shooter

> Sharp-Shooter is a turn-based shooter for two players on one phone, played with printed cards and the phone
> camera (WebAR). It runs in the browser over HTTPS; the camera only looks for the cards, and nothing is recorded or
> uploaded.

Two agents face each other on the table: Agent A (CT, FBI) with the AK-47, FAMAS F1 and PP-19 Bizon, and Agent B
(T, Balkan) with the M14, SKS Type 56 and Vz. 61 Skorpion. Each agent has 200 HP. On your turn, lay one of your
weapon cards beside your agent to fire. Every shot is a hit (65%), a critical for 1.5× damage (20%), or a
malfunction that does nothing and still uses the turn (15%). The first agent to reach 0 HP loses.

## Playing

1. Print the card sheet on A4 at 100% scale and cut along the dashed lines.
2. Open the game on a phone, press Start match and allow the camera.
3. Show both agent cards, then take turns laying a weapon card beside your agent. Lift it before your next turn.

- [Sharp-Shooter](https://sharpshooter.thitichotk.com/): the game (needs a phone camera)
- [Card sheet](https://sharpshooter.thitichotk.com/cards): the printable cards
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/thitichotk/sharp-shooter): code under the MIT licence; the 3D models keep their own licences
